title: Executive Office for Ghosh Diagnostics
subtitle: Executive Consultation & Administrative Office
description: An executive consultation and administrative workspace designed for Ghosh Diagnostics, balancing professional meetings, operational efficiency and a refined corporate healthcare identity.
style: Contemporary | Minimal | Warm Modern Healthcare Interior
body: Designed as the executive workspace for Ghosh Diagnostics, this office brings together management, doctors and healthcare partners in a refined, functional environment. Warm materials, integrated storage and thoughtful lighting create a professional space that supports everyday operations while reflecting the organization's identity.
features.0.title: Executive Meeting & Consultation Space
features.0.text: Designed to accommodate board discussions, meetings with visiting doctors, healthcare professionals, corporate representatives and confidential patient counselling sessions within a comfortable and professional setting.
features.1.title: Efficient Administrative Workspace
features.1.text: Dedicated workstations, integrated storage and organized document management support the daily administrative operations of the diagnostic centre while maintaining a clean and uncluttered environment.
features.2.title: Designed Around Everyday Use
features.2.text: Every element was planned around how the office functions on a daily basis—from meetings and consultations to paperwork and discussions—making the space both practical and visually refined.
highlights.0.title: Space-Efficient Functional Planning
highlights.0.text: Every part of the office was planned to accommodate multiple functions—including administration, executive meetings and counselling—without compromising openness or workflow.
highlights.1.title: Corporate Healthcare Identity
highlights.1.text: The overall design expresses a modern corporate image while supporting the day-to-day management and collaborative activities of the diagnostic centre.
highlights.2.title: Warm Contemporary Material Palette
highlights.2.text: Natural wood textures, soft neutral finishes and indirect lighting create an executive office environment that feels welcoming, calm and sophisticated.
highlights.3.title: Ambient Layered Lighting Design
highlights.3.text: Layered lighting enhances visual comfort throughout the workspace while highlighting architectural elements and improving the overall working environment.
